config.tacz_sewv.aiAimAccuracy.option.ac: Rare misses; crews shoot nearly as well as players.
config.tacz_sewv.aiAimAccuracy.option.re: Frequent misses and visible aim wobble.
config.tacz_sewv.aiAimAccuracy.option.sc: Moderate misses, a middle ground between realism and accuracy.
config.tacz_sewv.aiAimSpreadDegrees.tool: AI aim style: realistic (misses), scaled, or accurate (rare misses). aiAimAccuracy realistic realistic scaled accurate Extra aim wobble in degrees for realistic/scaled modes.
config.tacz_sewv.aiFireAssistConeDeg.too: How many degrees off-target an AI crew may still pull the trigger. Wider = more missed shots but less sitting silent. Existing configs keep their old value until you edit them.
config.tacz_sewv.aiFireCooldownTicks.too: Minimum wait between AI vehicle shots, in game ticks (20 = 1 second).
config.tacz_sewv.airportAlignmentDistanc: Length (blocks) of the alignment line an aircraft is placed on before an airport landing: the straight-in leg whose far end is this far back from the touchdown.
config.tacz_sewv.airportAlignmentSnapRad: How close (blocks) an aircraft must get to the start of that alignment line before it is placed onto it, pointed at the strip, and committed to the approach.
config.tacz_sewv.airportExtraTakeoffFact: Default extra takeoff room beyond the automatic baseline, as a fraction of runway length. The baseline is interpolated from the runway's size and always applies; this can only ADD to it, at the cost of parking slots.
config.tacz_sewv.airportLandingSearchRad: How far (blocks) from the AIRCRAFT to look for a cleared PMC airport when it is ordered to land. The ordered point is only a fallback, so raise this rather than clicking near the strip. 0 disables airport landings and keeps approach inference.
config.tacz_sewv.airportMaxAreaBlocks.to: Hard ceiling on runway footprint area (blocks). Rejects typo'd coordinates before they scan millions of columns on the server thread.
config.tacz_sewv.airportMinAspectRatio.t: Minimum long:short ratio for a player-defined PMC runway. Below this the strip is rejected as not runway-shaped.
Minimum long-side length (blocks) for a PMC runway. Matches the clear distance DrivePlaneGoal already demands for takeoff.
config.tacz_sewv.airportSlotBufferFactor: Default separation between adjacent parking slots, again as a fraction of runway length (floor 2 blocks). The last slot needs no buffer behind it.
config.tacz_sewv.airportSlotSizeFactor.t: Default parking slot length as a FRACTION of the runway's long side. Proportional rather than a block count so one setting suits a 64-block strip and a 400-block airbase; a floor of 8 blocks applies either way. Higher means fewer slots.
config.tacz_sewv.airportTaxiSpeed.toolti: Blocks per tick an aircraft backs up the runway toward its parking slot after touchdown.
config.tacz_sewv.artilleryChunkLoading.t: Keep crewed artillery vehicles loaded during long-range fire missions.
config.tacz_sewv.atBackupAmmo.tooltip: Extra rockets or missiles each anti-tank gunner is given.
config.tacz_sewv.atEngageRange.tooltip: Max distance (blocks) at which anti-tank gunners will fire.
config.tacz_sewv.atSecondGunnerChance.to: Chance a dismounted squad gets a second anti-tank gunner.
config.tacz_sewv.atWeaponRu.tooltip: Rocket/missile launcher given to RU soldiers who leave the vehicle to fight tanks.
config.tacz_sewv.atWeaponUs.tooltip: Rocket/missile launcher given to US soldiers who leave the vehicle to fight tanks.
config.tacz_sewv.autoBoardEnabled.toolti: Idle RU/US soldiers may climb into empty abandoned vehicles.
config.tacz_sewv.autoBoardMinHealthFract: Ignore wrecks below this health (0.25 = 25%). Derelicts should stay below this.
config.tacz_sewv.autoBoardScanRadius.too: How far (blocks) they look for empty vehicles.
config.tacz_sewv.autoBoardStealsPlayerVe: If on, RU/US may take vehicles you have driven before. Off by default.
config.tacz_sewv.autoEntrenchEnabled.too: Idle RU/US soldiers may claim nearby trench networks, emplacements, or free sandbags.
How far (blocks) they look for trench cells, emplacements, or sandbags.
config.tacz_sewv.autoManMortarEnabled.to: Idle RU/US soldiers may crew an empty, unclaimed mortar (same feature as autoBoardEnabled, for mortars).
config.tacz_sewv.autoManMortarScanRadius: How far (blocks) they look for empty mortars.
config.tacz_sewv.awarenessCuesEnabled.to: Let idle crews investigate sounds (vehicle engines, cannon fire, crew radio). Independent of outerRingEnabled, entity band polling can be off while hearing stays on.
config.tacz_sewv.ballisticTranslationDeb: Print TaCZ→SBW ballistic translation for every translated hit.
config.tacz_sewv.boardScanRadius.tooltip: How far (blocks) nearby units can be selected for boarding and similar orders.
config.tacz_sewv.colorPmc.tooltip: PMC colour as six hex digits (RRGGBB), e.g. 55FF55.
config.tacz_sewv.colorRu.tooltip: RU colour as six hex digits (RRGGBB), e.g. FF5555.
config.tacz_sewv.colorUs.tooltip: US colour as six hex digits (RRGGBB), e.g. 5555FF.
config.tacz_sewv.commandEngagementRadius: Enemy forces must be this close (blocks) before battle groups form.
How close (blocks) a vehicle must be to a battle group's centre to join it.
config.tacz_sewv.commandGroupLeaveRadius: How far (blocks) before a member leaves the group. Must be larger than join radius.
config.tacz_sewv.commandGroupMaxDiameter: Largest allowed size of a battle group (blocks across). Should be at least twice the leave radius.
config.tacz_sewv.commandGroupMinSize.too: Minimum crewed vehicles to form a battle group. Loners keep fighting on their own.
config.tacz_sewv.commandMargin.tooltip: How much better a new commander must score to replace the current one.
config.tacz_sewv.commandMaxUnits.tooltip: Max drivers the commander AI looks at in one pass (performance limit).
config.tacz_sewv.commanderSidearmPool.to: Pistols PMC Commanders may carry (TACZ gun ids).
config.tacz_sewv.convoyBaseChance.toolti: Starting chance each time Simple Enemy Mod checks for a convoy.
config.tacz_sewv.convoyEventsEnabled.too: Allow convoy events (vehicles on the move).
config.tacz_sewv.convoyFailureMultiplier: How much the convoy chance grows after each miss (until it fires).
config.tacz_sewv.coverCacheBakeCellsPerT: Cover Cache Bake Cells Per Tick
Max 2x2 cover cells rebaked per server tick across all dimensions (budget). 64 cells = one chunk.
config.tacz_sewv.coverCacheEnabled.toolt: Shared Killzone-style cover visibility table (2x2 columns, 8 compass dirs at turret height). Used by individual tactics for exposure / keyhole / scoot without per-tick raycasts.
config.tacz_sewv.creativeAmmoFallback.to: If a vehicle's normal ammo type cannot be figured out, fall back to a creative ammo box.
config.tacz_sewv.darkAccuracyFraction.to: How accurate AI vehicle guns are in the dark with no night vision on board (0.55 ≈ 45% worse). Also limited by darkSpreadScaleMax so spread cannot get worse than that cap.
config.tacz_sewv.darkBlockLightMax.toolt: During the day, places this dark or darker count as dark for accuracy (0-15 light scale). Night always counts as dark. Open daylight is bright from the sky, so outdoors stays accurate.
config.tacz_sewv.darkSpreadScaleMax.tool: Worst allowed shot spread in darkness vs daytime. 2.0 means at most twice as wide.
config.tacz_sewv.defaultNameCategory.too: Server-wide fallback name pool category (see the names datapack for the category list), used whenever no per-player preference applies - an ownerless spawn, an offline owner, or a player who never set one via the TDT's Identity/\ control. \ draws the name and surname independently from every category's pooled union.
config.tacz_sewv.derelictAmmoCount.toolt: How much ammo is left inside a derelict hull.
config.tacz_sewv.derelictBaseChance.tool: Starting chance each time Simple Enemy Mod checks for a derelict.
config.tacz_sewv.derelictEventsEnabled.t: Allow wrecked vehicles with a few survivors nearby.
config.tacz_sewv.derelictFailureMultipli: How much the derelict chance grows after each miss.
config.tacz_sewv.derelictGuards.tooltip: Max survivors standing near a derelict hull.
How healthy a derelict hull is (0.15 = 15%). Keep this below autoBoardMinHealthFraction so nearby enemy infantry do not climb in and drive it away.
config.tacz_sewv.droneBroadcastRadius.to: How far (blocks) drone-related map/crew lookups reach.
config.tacz_sewv.droneDeployChance.toolt: Chance each check actually launches a drone.
config.tacz_sewv.droneDeployCheckInterva: How often (game ticks) an engineer considers launching another drone.
config.tacz_sewv.droneLeashRadius.toolti: Max distance (blocks) a wandering drone may stray from its engineer.
config.tacz_sewv.droneMaxPerEngineer.too: Max attack drones each RU/US engineer may have out at once.
config.tacz_sewv.droneScanAltitude.toolt: How high (blocks) drones cruise above the ground while searching.
How often (game ticks) a diving drone looks for a new target.
config.tacz_sewv.dubinsAlignToleranceDeg: Heading error (degrees) off the alignment line's own axis within which an aircraft is treated as already lined up and just flies straight in. Past this it flies a turn (a Dubins arc, sized off the hull's own measured turn radius) onto the line instead of arriving on the wrong heading and being placed straight.
config.tacz_sewv.dubinsDeviationThreshol: How far (blocks) an aircraft may drift off its computed turn-in arc, from a nearby explosion, for instance, before the arc is recomputed from where it actually is.
config.tacz_sewv.dubinsFallbackMultiplie: If the computed turn-in arc would be longer than this many times the straight-line distance to the alignment line, the geometry is treated as degenerate (radius too wide for how close the aircraft already is) and the turn is skipped in favour of the ordinary straight run-in.
Wait between repair actions, in AI ticks (about every other game tick).
Vehicle health restored each time an engineer repairs.
config.tacz_sewv.engineerRepairSpeedBoos: Movement speed multiplier for an engineer while tasked with reaching a repair target (1.0 = no boost). Without it a foot unit can be permanently outrun by the tank it was sent to fix.
config.tacz_sewv.engineerSearchRadius.to: How far (blocks) engineers look for damaged vehicles to repair.
config.tacz_sewv.engineerSidearmPool.too: Pistols engineers may carry (TACZ gun ids).
config.tacz_sewv.engineerSpawnChance.too: Chance an RU/US group includes an engineer.
config.tacz_sewv.factionColorsEnabled.to: Tint Superb Warfare's vehicle hover text by who is crewing it (RU / US / PMC).
config.tacz_sewv.factionInfiniteAmmo.too: Vehicles crewed by RU or US never run out of ammo.
config.tacz_sewv.factionInfiniteEnergy.t: Vehicles crewed by RU or US never run out of energy/fuel.
config.tacz_sewv.factionOrganicComms.too: RU/US crews can call mortars/TOWs/air support without holding a radio item.
config.tacz_sewv.farEventSpawns.tooltip: Multiply SEM event spawn distance by 2.5 for wider, more spread-out fights.
config.tacz_sewv.fobBufferFactor.tooltip: Threat-detection span as a multiple of FOB master size. Wider than the base itself so the garrison watches the approaches.
config.tacz_sewv.fobDebug.tooltip: FOB route, assign, resupply, and stale-state logging.
config.tacz_sewv.fobMasterSize.tooltip: Horizontal span of the FOB master area (blocks, centered on quarters_bench).
config.tacz_sewv.fobParkingSize.tooltip: Horizontal span of the parking sub-area (blocks, centered on block).
Default Periodic Refill interval for a new FOB (ticks, 20 = 1 second; 0 = off). Editable per FOB at the quarters bench.
config.tacz_sewv.fobStockpileSize.toolti: Horizontal span of the stockpile sub-area (blocks, centered on block).
config.tacz_sewv.fobThreatEvalIntervalTi: Ticks between threat scans per FOB.
config.tacz_sewv.fobThreatThreshold.tool: Threat score at or above this triggers scramble.
config.tacz_sewv.friendlyFireMortarRadiu: Mortars hold fire when the aimpoint is this close (blocks) to the owning player or a friendly PMC. Should be at least mortarDispersionRadius. 0 disables.
config.tacz_sewv.friendlyFireVehicleRadi: AI vehicle weapons (including TOWs) hold fire when the target is this close (blocks) to the owning player or a friendly PMC. 0 disables.
config.tacz_sewv.garrisonVehicleChance.t: Chance a village garrison gets that tank.
config.tacz_sewv.garrisonVehiclesEnabled: Let village garrisons sometimes get one crewed tank.
config.tacz_sewv.grenadeMaxHand.tooltip: Lifetime NBT cap of M67 hand grenades one unit may throw. 0 disables that type.
config.tacz_sewv.grenadeMaxRgo.tooltip: Lifetime NBT cap of RGO grenades one unit may throw. 0 disables that type.
config.tacz_sewv.grenadeMaxSmoke.tooltip: Lifetime NBT cap of M18 smoke grenades one unit may throw. 0 disables that type.
config.tacz_sewv.grenadeThrowCadence.opt: HE within 30 blocks; smoke up to 48. About every 2.5 seconds.
HE 8–24 blocks; smoke up to 40. About every 5 seconds.
HE within 16 blocks; smoke up to 32. About every 12 seconds.
config.tacz_sewv.grenadeThrowCadence.too: How often on-foot units throw hand grenades.
config.tacz_sewv.groundPathingDebug.tool: Log ground vehicle pathing and shoreline probes.
config.tacz_sewv.healthMobilityEnabled.t: Damaged AI vehicles move more slowly.
config.tacz_sewv.healthMobilityFloor.too: Slowest a wrecked hull still moves (0.4 = 40% of normal speed).
config.tacz_sewv.heatRaySpeed.tooltip: Speed of Extermination heat-ray shots. The original mod uses 3.5; default 10.5 is triple that.
config.tacz_sewv.heliChunkLoading.toolti: Keep AI helicopters active even when no player is nearby (uses chunk tickets). Default true (matches mortarChunkLoading). Existing installs keep whatever value is already in tacz_sewv-common.toml until that file is deleted.
config.tacz_sewv.heliCombatDebug.tooltip: Helicopter combat and run-phase diagnosis (logs and overlay).
config.tacz_sewv.heliEngageRadius.toolti: Preferred horizontal distance (blocks) for helicopter cannon/rocket attacks. Missile attacks use heliMinStandoff and heliMaxDepressionDeg instead.
config.tacz_sewv.heliFarLodBlocks.toolti: Same FAR band for AI helicopters (cheaper ground-cache TTL when far from players).
config.tacz_sewv.heliMaxDepressionDeg.to: Steepest nose-down angle (degrees) for missile attacks. Higher = can sit closer above the target.
config.tacz_sewv.heliMinStandoff.tooltip: Closest horizontal range (blocks) for helicopter missile attacks, even when the target is on a tall peak.
config.tacz_sewv.heliShowRunPhase.toolti: On AI helicopters, append the current attack phase to the hover name (approach, attack, break away, and so on).
config.tacz_sewv.helmetGrayscale.tooltip: Desaturate only the PMC MICH DogTag (not the whole helmet) to low-contrast grey; transparent logo pixels stay transparent.
config.tacz_sewv.highChanceMortarShell.t: Usual mortar shell type for spawned crews (item id).
Usual rocket for MLRS emplacements in the mortar pool (e.g. Type-63; item id).
config.tacz_sewv.hudNeutralColor.tooltip: Invasion HUD colour for unowned capture points. Six hex digits, e.g. AAAAAA.
config.tacz_sewv.hudTeamAColor.tooltip: Invasion HUD colour for team A (left base). Six hex digits, e.g. 5555FF.
config.tacz_sewv.hudTeamBColor.tooltip: Invasion HUD colour for team B (right base). Six hex digits, e.g. FF5555.
config.tacz_sewv.idleFormationBaseRadius: Base polygon radius (blocks) for IDLE_HOLD; scales with group size.
config.tacz_sewv.idleGroupRadius.tooltip: Friendly idle ground vehicles within this range form an idle group.
config.tacz_sewv.idleHoldMaxTicks.toolti: Maximum IDLE_HOLD duration (game ticks) before travel begins (200 = 10 s).
config.tacz_sewv.idleHoldMinTicks.toolti: Minimum IDLE_HOLD duration (game ticks) before travel may begin (100 = 5 s).
config.tacz_sewv.idleHybridEnabled.toolt: Ground crews use polygon formation hold + constant-bearing travel when idle instead of random wander. Ships still use idleWanderEnabled.
config.tacz_sewv.idleScrambleRadius.tool: Persistent random XZ offset (±blocks) per formation slot.
Cancel IDLE_TRAVEL when a non-group VehicleEntity or Player is within this range.
How far ahead (blocks) the travel leader pathfinds along its bearing.
config.tacz_sewv.idleTravelSpacingMax.to: Maximum column spacing (blocks) between travel followers.
config.tacz_sewv.idleTravelSpacingMin.to: Minimum column spacing (blocks) between travel followers.
config.tacz_sewv.idleTravelStuckTicks.to: Give up IDLE_TRAVEL and re-enter hold if no progress for this many game ticks.
config.tacz_sewv.idleVoicelineDelayTicks: Quiet time (game ticks) before idle crew chatter starts.
config.tacz_sewv.idleVoicelineHealthFrac: No idle chatter when the vehicle is below this health (0.3 = 30%).
config.tacz_sewv.idleWanderEnabled.toolt: Ship crews with nothing to do may wander nearby on water. Ground hulls use hybrid idle (IDLE_HOLD / IDLE_TRAVEL) when idleHybridEnabled.
config.tacz_sewv.idleWanderRadius.toolti: Max wander distance (blocks) from where they started waiting.
config.tacz_sewv.ifvDismountsEnabled.too: IFVs (troop carriers) drop their squad when fighting enemy armor.
Log cover-cache bake and per-crew posture.
config.tacz_sewv.individualTacticsEnable: Per-crew tactical posture (shoot-and-scoot, covering advance, keyhole, ambush, infantry cover). Soft biases only under player/command orders, never freezes a push.
config.tacz_sewv.influenceCellSize.toolt: Grid cell size (blocks) for the rough who-controls-this-area map. Bigger cells = cheaper, coarser.
config.tacz_sewv.influenceMaxCells.toolt: Max cells that map may use. Huge battles automatically use bigger cells instead of more of them.
config.tacz_sewv.invasionBaseChance.tool: Starting chance each time Simple Enemy Mod checks for an invasion.
config.tacz_sewv.invasionDefenderInfantr: How many defending foot soldiers spawn in an invasion.
config.tacz_sewv.invasionDefenderTows.to: How many defending anti-tank launchers (TOWs) spawn.
config.tacz_sewv.invasionEventsEnabled.t: Allow invasion events (attackers vs a defended position).
config.tacz_sewv.invasionFailureMultipli: How much the invasion chance grows after each miss.
With gamerule sewvInvasionOverrides on: AI vehicles stay this many blocks away from Extermination combat pods.
Skip unsafe off-thread Komodo lightmap uploads that can crash the client. Leave on unless isolating a Komodo bug.
config.tacz_sewv.largeCombatBaseChance.t: Starting chance each time Simple Enemy Mod checks for a large battle.
config.tacz_sewv.largeCombatEmplacementC: Per side: chance to also spawn a mortar or TOW launcher.
config.tacz_sewv.largeCombatFailureMulti: How much the large-battle chance grows after each miss.
Per side: chance to also spawn a plane.
config.tacz_sewv.largeCombatVehicles.too: How many vehicles each side gets in a large battle.
config.tacz_sewv.lowChanceMortarShell.to: Less common mortar shell type for spawned crews (item id).
config.tacz_sewv.lowChanceType63Rocket.t: Less common rocket for MLRS emplacements in the mortar pool (item id).
config.tacz_sewv.mapInfantryEnabled.tool: Also show soldiers on foot on the world map (not only vehicles).
config.tacz_sewv.mapLive.tooltip: In singleplayer, keep the world running while Xaero's map screen is open (otherwise the game pauses and markers go stale).
config.tacz_sewv.mapMarkersEnabled.toolt: Show unit and vehicle markers on Xaero's World Map, and allow ordering from the map. You can also toggle this in-game with the map markers keybind.
config.tacz_sewv.mapShowCommandDebug.too: Developer overlay: battle-group commander marks, play names, and per-tank role tags.
config.tacz_sewv.mapShowEnergyBar.toolti: Draw an energy/fuel bar under your own PMC vehicle markers.
config.tacz_sewv.mapShowHealthBar.toolti: Draw a health bar under your own PMC vehicle markers.
config.tacz_sewv.mapShowIcons.tooltip: Draw vehicle-type icons on map markers.
config.tacz_sewv.mapSpotRadius.tooltip: How far (blocks) your side can spot enemy markers (via you or your crews).
config.tacz_sewv.mapSyncIntervalTicks.to: How often (game ticks) the server refreshes map markers.
config.tacz_sewv.mapTrenchMarkersEnabled: Show trench-network and emplacement markers on Xaero's World Map.
config.tacz_sewv.maxChunkArea.tooltip: Largest map selection (width × height in chunks) allowed for Sweep & Advance.
config.tacz_sewv.medicCaptureDurationTic: Ticks a captured medic has before escaping. 2400 = 2 minutes.
config.tacz_sewv.medicCaptureEnabled.too: RU/US medics may be captured (defeated) and converted to PMC units for a cost.
config.tacz_sewv.medicCapturedHealth.too: Health an RU/US medic is left with the moment it is captured.
config.tacz_sewv.medicEnabled.tooltip: PMC soldiers carrying a medical kit can heal allies when not in a fight.
config.tacz_sewv.medicFleeDetectionRadiu: How far (blocks) medics look for a nearby hostile before fleeing.

config.tacz_sewv.planeAutoHeavyRange.too: AUTO ordnance: bombs and guided missiles are only used from at least this far out. Between this and planeAutoRocketRange the plane uses rockets. This tracks the release geometry, not the engage bubble: a bomb let go from the 80-block run altitude falls for about 52 ticks and travels roughly 125 blocks downrange at cruise, so anything nearer than that cannot be bombed at all.
config.tacz_sewv.planeAutoRocketRange.to: AUTO ordnance: closer than this (blocks) to the target, a plane uses guns only. Heavier stores need room to fall or to guide, so the closer the target the fewer of them are eligible.
config.tacz_sewv.planeBombSightRadius.to: Smallest release window (blocks) a plane will ever bomb through - a FLOOR under the window, not the window itself. The window is normally the bomb's own blast radius, on the reasoning that a release is worth taking when the target will be inside the explosion rather than only when the bomb will land on it; that is what absorbs the few blocks of track error an AI pass cannot help and the distance a target drives during the fall. A Mk 82's 22-block blast therefore gives a window far wider than this, and this only binds for a store whose datapack declares no blast at all. Raising it does not make planes bomb more accurately, it makes them release earlier; if planes overfly without dropping, the run-in is what to look at, and planeCombatDebug prints the sight error that says which part of it.
config.tacz_sewv.planeBombStick.tooltip: How many bombs a plane releases in one carpet run, spaced along its track. 1 is a single aimed drop.
config.tacz_sewv.planeBombStickIntervalT: Game ticks between bombs in a carpet stick. Wider spacing covers more ground and concentrates less on the aim point. There is a hard floor of 10 ticks in code: closer than that the impacts overlap into one blast instead of walking across the target, so a smaller number here does nothing.
config.tacz_sewv.planeChunkLoading.toolt: Keep AI planes active even when no player is nearby (uses chunk tickets). Default true (matches mortarChunkLoading). Existing installs keep whatever value is already in tacz_sewv-common.toml until that file is deleted.
config.tacz_sewv.planeCombatDebug.toolti: Fixed-wing combat and landing diagnosis (logs and client arcs).
config.tacz_sewv.planeCommandRadius.tool: Max distance (blocks) for player orders to aircraft. Doubles as the soft leash: past this a plane finishes its pass and returns to you. Combat is abandoned outright at 1.5x this distance. Must stay comfortably larger than planeEngageRadius: a plane repositions by flying outbound until it is clear of its own engage bubble before turning back in, so a leash near the bubble size recalls it in the middle of every run-in.
config.tacz_sewv.planeDiveSnap.tooltip: Place a plane exactly on its attack line at the moment it rolls in on a diving pass (guns and rockets; bombs and guided missiles are released from level flight and are unaffected). The same trick the airport approach uses, and for the same reason: a fixed wing is pointed a fraction of a degree per tick, so anything not corrected before the run is still being corrected during it, and the burst goes wide. Turn off if you would rather planes never be repositioned.
config.tacz_sewv.planeEngageRadius.toolt: How far out (blocks) a plane rolls in on a target instead of just closing on it. This is the single number that sets the scale a plane operates at: it is the length of the straight run-in, and the run-in is where the aircraft has to get its nose onto the target. A plane is pointed by hauling the whole hull round at a fraction of a degree per tick, so a short bubble is a short line, and a short line is a pass flown with the gun still swinging through the aim point. Lowering this makes planes commit sooner and hit less.
config.tacz_sewv.planeFarLodBlocks.toolt: Past this distance from every player, a ticketed plane in cruise/hold/RTB uses cheaper scans. Combat, takeoff and landing stay full fidelity.
config.tacz_sewv.planeGunConeDeg.tooltip: Widest angle (degrees) off the gun line at which a plane will fire guns, rockets and bombs. This is a ceiling, not the gate itself: the plane works out the angle at which the shot would still land inside the weapon's own blast radius at the current range and uses that, so it holds fire far out and lets go up close. It only binds in very close: an A-10 cannon (4-block blast) reaches 12 degrees at 19 blocks, so past that the derived angle is what decides.
config.tacz_sewv.planeLandFlareAgl.toolt: Height (blocks) above ground at which a landing plane flares.
config.tacz_sewv.planeLandFlareRadius.to: How close (blocks) to the pad the plane must also be before it flares. Height alone used to make it flare over whatever it happened to be crossing.
config.tacz_sewv.planeLandSettleRadius.t: How close (blocks) to the pad a touchdown counts as landed. Touching down further out is treated as a missed approach and the plane goes around.
config.tacz_sewv.planeLandTransitAgl.too: Height (blocks) above the highest ground on the way in that a landing plane flies the approach pattern at, before it lines up with the strip.
config.tacz_sewv.planeMaxAltitude.toolti: Absolute world Y a plane will never fly above. This is a ceiling, not a cruise height: the cruise band is measured above the ground under the aircraft, so over high terrain it would otherwise stack on top of a mountain and put the aircraft in the stratosphere - out of sight, out of the fight, and above the build limit in a dimension with a low one. Every climb this AI commands stops here, and the dimension's own build height (less a little headroom) binds it further.
config.tacz_sewv.planeMinConeDeg.tooltip: Floor under the derived firing angle above. It is a numerical backstop and nothing else, and it is set so that it does not bind anywhere inside the engage bubble - geometry governs every shot you will ever see. Do NOT raise this to make reluctant planes shoot. The miss distance of a shot fired X degrees off at range R is R*tan(X), so a wide floor buys shots precisely where they cannot land: at 2 degrees an A-10 may fire from 384 blocks and miss by 13, against a 4-block blast. The derived angle is instead a range gate in disguise - it stays shut until the plane is close enough that the accuracy it can actually hold puts the round inside the blast (7.6 degrees at 30 blocks, 5.1 at 45, 2.4 at 96). A plane that finishes passes without firing is a plane that is not getting close or not lining up; look at planeEngageRadius and the run-in. Note this must be re-checked against planeEngageRadius if that is raised: the floor stops being harmless the moment the bubble reaches out past where it binds.
config.tacz_sewv.planeMissileConeDeg.too: Same ceiling for guided missiles, which steer out the rest after launch. Doubles as the seeker cone the lock dwell below is measured against.
config.tacz_sewv.planeMissileLockTicks.t: Game ticks a guided missile's seeker must be held on the target, unbroken, before it will launch (20 = 1 second). Leaving the firing cone resets it to zero. This is why a missile pass is flown as a shallow dive rather than a level overfly: the nose has to stay pointed at the target for the whole count. 0 disables the dwell and launches on the first tick the cone is satisfied, which is the old behaviour and reliably threw missiles off during a slew.

gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.altitude.tip: Cruise altitude held above the terrain in blocks. Press Takeoff again to retrim an aircraft that is already flying.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.attack.tip: Close the terminal, then left-click an entity for selected units to attack.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.bail_out.tip: Abandon ship — every owned PMC on the selected hulls gets a parachute and jumps (scramble + stand-down). Not a simple dismount.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.board.tip: Aim at a vehicle or mortar, then press Board. Uses the live crosshair when you click, not the aim from when the terminal opened.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.board_passenger.tip: Board the vehicle you are looking at, but only into non-driver seats. Units wait beside an empty hull rather than taking the wheel.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.capture_medic.tip: Selected units walk to the nearest medic, subdue it if it is not already captured, and auto-convert it to a PMC, paying from your own inventory. Only engages once idle (no target). Refused if no medic is in range.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.dismiss.tip: Stand crews down off Patrol, Search & Destroy, Entrench (trench or sandbag) or a plotted Cruise and return them to their normal behavior. They stay in their Vehicles sandbag seats are cleared here, not via Dismount.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.emergency_land.tip: Put aircraft down on any flat ground near where they are. No airport and no aiming needed; a rough arrival, but an arrival.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.entrench.tip: Left-click a trench, foxhole, emplacement or sandbag. Selected units crew free weapons first, then hold cells / seat sandbags. Clear with Dismiss.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.escort.tip: Select units on the ribbon first, then left-click a vehicle for them to stick beside and defend. Right-click cancels.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.exit_platoon.tip: Selected unit(s) leave their platoon. Ends cohesion and any standing platoon order for them.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.full_names.tip: Sets which name pool your future PMC recruits are drawn from. Does not rename units you already own.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.join_platoon.tip: Select units first, then left-click a Commander for them to join its platoon. Type (on-foot / vehicle) and capacity are checked per unit. Right-click cancels.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.land.tip: Send planes home to the nearest cleared runway (planes only; helicopters use helipads). Aim at a distant airfield to send them to that one instead. Refused if no airport is in range — use Emergency Land for that.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.land_helipad.tip: Selected helicopter pilots land on the nearest cleared, free helipad. Runways are for planes only.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.line.tip: Vehicles per rank in a Line formation. Once a rank is full the next vehicle starts a new rank behind it.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.logo_icon.tip: Click the icon to pick from the selected pool. Stamped on PMC-captured vehicles.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.move_to.tip: Close the terminal, then left-click a block to send selected units there.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.paratroop.tip: Drop weaponless passengers with parachutes (same seat filter as Rappel). Pilot and gunners stay aboard.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.patrol.tip: Radius of the patrol area around you in blocks. Crews wander inside it moving to a new spot after a bit, until you dismiss them. Minimum 48.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.pmc_company.tip: Company name shown on a second line under each owned PMC's name. Apply to update existing units.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.rappel.tip: Hover and drop weaponless passengers down the ropes.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.reach_guard.tip: Move selected vehicle crews to their cached GUARD position, then hold there. Greyed out when no guard is set.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.route_to_fob.tip: Recall all assigned FOB vehicles and infantry to the parking field. Greyed out without a valid FOB layout or assigned vehicles.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.search.tip: Radius of the area to sweep, in blocks. A one-time assignment: each vehicle covers its own slice of the area, and the first contact alerts every vehicle on the task onto that target. Minimum 48.
gui.tacz_sewv.tdt.set_guard.tip: Select units first, then left-click a block in the world to cache as their GUARD position. Overwrites any previous guard. Right-click cancels.
